text: My kitchen smells really strongly of gas.
Please leave the building right now and don't touch any light switches or appliances. Once you're outside, call 911 or your gas utility's emergency line. Are you in a safe place outside right now?
Thank you for getting outside safely. What is the address of the building where you smelled gas?
Thank you. And what is a good callback phone number for you?
I have logged your safety report for 44 Lexington Ave. Please stay outside and wait for emergency services or your gas utility to respond.
Could someone also come check the stove tomorrow?

For gas leaks or gas smells, we cannot book service appointments until the utility or fire department has inspected and cleared the building. Please give your gas utility or 911 a call right away to make sure the area is safe.
Okay, I'll call them now. Thanks.
You're welcome. Please stay safe, and have a good night.
